fusions.name: Plunging Point
fusions.desc: A dive from range that deals 38 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Seam Peck
fusions.desc: Pecks for 4 damage, leaving the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Eye for the Gap
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Threaded Marks
fusions.desc: Every hit you land marks that enemy, up to 4. Your next critical hit on it spends them all and strikes it for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a mark fades every 4 seconds.
